title: ATM fee rebates for Bluest
summary: This document explains Bluest Account debit card ATM fee rebates: a $1,500 daily ATM withdrawal limit (per 24-hour period) and ATM fee rebates capped at $50 per month. Rebates are credited until the $50 monthly maximum is reached; any aggregate fees above $50 are not rebated.
